decision.purpose: Prospective development experiment adding Town01 right-turn training while retaining Town03 val337 and untouched Town04 test.
decision.budget: Same 1540 optimizer-step budget as the preceding campaign; 287 batches per expanded epoch, approximately 5.37 epochs, not 10 epochs.
decision.comparison: Exploratory cross-corpus comparison only. The old v2 and expanded v3 corpus fingerprints differ; do not claim compare.py compatibility across those corpora.
decision.test_policy: Never evaluate or select on held-out Town04 test during this campaign.
decision.promotion: No automatic promotion, no control approval; independent test, scenario coverage, 10Hz shadow and closed-loop gates remain mandatory.
